info.title: XR Business Management & POS API
info.description: Generated from the running router by scripts/generate-openapi.js. Errors use RFC 9457 application/problem+json with a stable `code`. Request/response schemas for request bodies are documented; response payloads are described by the generic envelope {success, data} (see docs/contracts/FE_BE_CONTRACT.md for field-level shapes).
